note: Entries are hypothesis records, not architecture. External corroboration does not automatically raise registered claim confidence. Language-derived evidence must not be used as a training oracle for latent-discovery experiments.

records.definition: A recoverable relation allowing a cognitive system to treat representations as concerning the same entity across time, transformation, occlusion, remapping or engine-specific encoding. The candidate is an equivalence/continuity relation, not a fixed symbolic object identifier.

linguistic_evidence.summary: Natural Semantic Metalanguage proposes THIS, THE SAME, OTHER, SOMEONE, SOMETHING, KIND and PART among cross-linguistic semantic primes; semantic-map methods offer a way to test recurrent neighbourhood structure without assuming identical categories.
linguistic_evidence.caveat: NSM is a contested theory of human semantics and cannot establish substrate-neutral cognition.

developmental_evidence.summary: Infant object-individuation work shows early use of spatiotemporal continuity for identity, with later integration of property and kind information; object permanence is present early but task-sensitive.

neural_evidence.summary: Hippocampal-entorhinal work supports relational maps and structural knowledge that can persist across changes in sensory particulars; this is compatible with identity being relationally maintained rather than stored as one surface feature.

comparative_evidence.summary: Object permanence and related individuation capacities occur across non-human species, though developmental pathways and task performance vary.

artificial_agent_evidence.summary: State-abstraction and bisimulation work formalises when distinct observations may map to the same functional abstract state while preserving downstream control-relevant structure.

ree_evidence.summary: REE already requires self/world distinction, persistent world modelling and later object/entity permanence; the cognitive-contract thought predicts identity-translation lesions causing duplicated or discontinuous entities.

records.lesion_prediction: At an otherwise functioning translation boundary, selectively disrupting sameness/continuity should produce duplicate-entity representations, broken persistence, unstable memory integration or incoherent credit assignment while preserving unrelated content.
records.alternative_explanation: Human and animal object continuity may be an embodied adaptation to persisting physical objects rather than a universal requirement of all possible minds. A more general invariant may be equivalence/class identity over state transitions.

records.definition: Recoverable ordering and temporal-context relations sufficient to distinguish present, prior and possible future states and to preserve trajectory structure across representations. Human clock units and tense morphology are not assumed primitive.

linguistic_evidence.summary: Cross-linguistic semantics recurrently encodes temporal relations; NSM proposes WHEN/TIME, NOW, BEFORE and AFTER as primes, while tense/aspect typology shows substantial variation in how languages package time.
linguistic_evidence.caveat: Specific tense systems are not universal and should not be equated with the cognitive invariant.

developmental_evidence.summary: Core-knowledge and event-representation literatures treat persistent objects and actions as temporally structured; the exact developmental status of metric time is less secure than ordering/continuity.

neural_evidence.summary: Hippocampal time cells and temporal-context coding organise sequential moments in memories and integrate with spatial/event representations.

comparative_evidence.summary: Temporal coding and episodic-like memory occur across animal species; hippocampal time coding has been observed across species and humans.

artificial_agent_evidence.summary: Successor representations, temporal abstraction and transition-preserving state abstractions show that future-state structure is a reusable basis for control and generalisation.

ree_evidence.summary: REE explicitly requires temporal coherence, E2 rollout, hippocampal trajectory proposal and future-vs-present distinction; temporal translation lesion is pre-registered in MECH-545.

records.lesion_prediction: Preserve state content while scrambling temporal relation at a boundary. Expected dissociations include cause/effect inversion, present/future confusion, impaired planning and contamination between memory and prediction.
records.alternative_explanation: Some observed temporal structure may derive from physical motion, memory sequencing or task requirements. The deeper invariant may be partial order/transition relation rather than a dedicated time coordinate.

records.definition: Recoverable relations sufficient to determine whether a represented event/action is attributable to self, another agent or ambient dynamics, and whether an action causally controlled an outcome. This may be a derived bundle rather than one primitive agency scalar.

linguistic_evidence.summary: Language recurrently marks participant roles, action/event distinctions and causal/modal relations. NSM independently includes I/YOU/SOMEONE, DO/HAPPEN, CAN and BECAUSE.

developmental_evidence.summary: Infants identify goal-directed agents and reason about motivational, epistemic and counterfactual states; broad AGENT-like kind concepts appear early in object-individuation work.

neural_evidence.summary: Sense-of-agency research combines prospective action selection/prediction with retrospective comparison of predicted and observed effects; evidence argues for multiple dissociable mechanisms rather than a unitary faculty.

comparative_evidence.summary: Goal-directed action understanding and social prediction occur in non-human species, but self-attribution/control evidence is more uneven across taxa.

artificial_agent_evidence.summary: Forward models, counterfactual control and transition models provide direct computational decompositions of action -> consequence and controllability; no single standard 'agency latent' is required.

ree_evidence.summary: Self-attribution is already a necessary REE comparator requiring z_self/z_world separation plus counterfactual rollout; SELF_IMPACT and responsibility flow provide existing substrate-side analogues.

records.lesion_prediction: At a translation boundary, preserve event and outcome content but corrupt actor/source or control relation. Expected failures: self/other misattribution, incorrect causal responsibility, impaired action learning, or intact event prediction with defective agency judgment.
records.alternative_explanation: Agency may not be primitive at all; it may be reconstructed from provenance, action identity, transition prediction, temporal contiguity and counterfactual controllability.

records.definition: Recoverable information allowing a system to distinguish where a representation came from and what status it currently has: externally constrained perception, recollection, internally generated simulation, prediction, counterfactual or committed/current belief. The working hypothesis is that provenance and actuality/commitment are separable coordinates.

linguistic_evidence.summary: Evidentiality encodes source of evidence and interacts with epistemic modality; NSM includes SEE, HEAR, THINK, KNOW, TRUE, MAYBE and related logical/modal primes.

developmental_evidence.summary: Source-monitoring abilities can be measured separately from content recognition in children and develop substantially across childhood.

neural_evidence.summary: Reality-monitoring research shows substantial overlap between imagination and perception at first-order levels; higher-level systems infer internal versus external source from sensory/contextual/cognitive cues. Recent meta-analysis separates external source monitoring from reality monitoring.

comparative_evidence.summary: Direct cross-species evidence for human-like reality monitoring is limited; related self-generated/external discrimination and metamemory capacities offer partial analogues.

artificial_agent_evidence.summary: World-model systems routinely require separation of observed data, imagined rollout and replay/training sources to avoid self-contamination, but this is more an engineering precedent than independent evidence of a universal primitive.

ree_evidence.summary: REE already has hypothesis/provenance and committed-versus-imagined protections across replay/consolidation; the parent intake identified this as the cheapest V3-buildable contract-lesion cousin.

records.lesion_prediction: Hold represented content constant while corrupting provenance or actuality status separately. Provenance lesions should produce source confusions; actuality/commit lesions should produce belief-like uptake of simulations or failure to treat real evidence as committed. A double dissociation would support decomposition.
records.alternative_explanation: Mode labels may be post-hoc judgments from sensory strength, temporal context, cognitive-operation cues and precision rather than stored coordinates. The contract may need only those cues plus a learned classifier.

records.definition: Recoverable uncertainty or confidence information governing how strongly content, source/status judgments or translations should constrain downstream cognition. Translation confidence is explicitly distinguished from confidence in the represented content.

linguistic_evidence.summary: Epistemic modality and evidential systems recurrently express possibility, necessity, evidence source and speaker commitment; NSM includes MAYBE, CAN, KNOW and TRUE.
linguistic_evidence.caveat: Language may externalise only selected portions of a richer internal uncertainty structure.

developmental_evidence.summary: Confidence monitoring and source monitoring improve over childhood; recent developmental theory links limitations to incomplete representation of alternative possibilities.

neural_evidence.summary: Metacognition/confidence is supported by a substantial psychological and neural literature and can be partly dissociated from first-order task performance.

comparative_evidence.summary: Uncertainty-monitoring and metacognition-like behaviours have been reported in dolphins, monkeys, apes, rats and some birds, although associative accounts remain debated.

artificial_agent_evidence.summary: Probabilistic world models, calibration, information bottlenecks and uncertainty-aware state estimation provide computational precedents. No standard framework yet establishes translation confidence as a distinct invariant.

ree_evidence.summary: REE already has precision routing and uncertainty-sensitive commitment, but the cognitive-contract intake explicitly identifies absence of a distinct confidence-in-translation variable as a substrate gap.

records.lesion_prediction: Preserve content and its nominal source/status while removing or miscalibrating confidence. Expected failures include overcommitment, underreaction to reliable evidence, inappropriate cross-engine update weight or failure to detect deteriorating translation quality despite intact content decoding.
records.alternative_explanation: Precision may be a control-plane operation rather than part of the contract payload. Translation confidence may emerge from reconstruction error/bridge complexity rather than requiring an explicit latent coordinate.
